For decades, the security industry has told buyers to choose best-of-breed security products, leaving practitioners to stitch them together. This has been perpetuated by the major analyst firms, which have a Wave for this product and a Magic Quadrant for that product. The reality is that choosing best-of-breed everywhere has never led to best-in-class threat protection. […]
